transcript.text: From what you have described, the most likely cause is unbalanced / uneven load. Does it keep turning slowly backwards and forwards as if trying to balance the load, and does it spin fine with a different, evenly-spread load?
yeah it sloshes back n forth, tries to speed up then slows down a few times. it was only a big rubber backed bath mat on its own tho. a full load yesterday spun fine

This sounds like normal behaviour rather than a fault: Machines deliberately skip or reduce the spin when a load is unbalanced (one heavy item, a small load, a duvet or a bath mat). Clothes then come out wet. It would be worth a closer look if it never spins even with a normal mixed load, or it hums without draining. Is the drum empty of water when it tries to spin, or is there water still in it?
no water in the drum, its empty just the wet mat
Could you tell me a bit more about what it is doing, and when it happens?
just today. washed the mat on its own, cycle finished normally and no error code, but the mat came out dripping. like i said it tries to spin then gives up
From what you have checked, this needs an appliance engineer to look at it: the next steps are beyond the checks that are safe to do yourself.
